newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police arrest 41 suspected militants.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police arrest 41 suspected militants.

text.p: Egyptian police have arrested 41 suspected Moslem militants and charged them with planning to attack police and tourists and possessing unlicensed weapons, state security sources said on Thursday.
They said the men were arrested in the Delta provinces of Beheira, Sharqiya and Dahaqliya over the past few days.
Police believe the men are members of Egypt's largest outlawed miliant organisation al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which has been fighting the government since 1992.
The group has targeted government ministers, policemen, Christians and tourists in a bid to set up a strict Islamic state.

Some of the detained men had been recruited into the Gama'a during religious lessons in mosques in the three provinces, the sources said. Police found Gama'a literature and video tapes promoting the group's ideology with the men.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence in Egypt since militants took up arms against the government.
